basic_profile.bio: A passionate software developer and puzzle enthusiast from Austin, Texas. With a background in computer science and a penchant for unraveling complex problems, I've been a part of the Reddit community for over seven years. I love diving deep into coding challenges and sharing my insights on education and technology. When I'm not online, you can find me exploring medieval history or catching up on the latest in entertainment. I'm currently in a relationship and work as a senior software engineer. I usually browse Reddit during the evening hours, Pacific Time.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in computer science and over a decade of experience in software development, I have a strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, and system design. I'm a self-taught historian in medieval studies, which I explore in my free time. My expertise is continually honed through community interactions and solving coding puzzles.
